notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Briber's Purse to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Briber's Purse.
Cast Briber's Purse.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
